prompt: Review whether TSMC has a material causal relationship to Japan strategic investment through the binding Kumamoto image-sensor joint venture, government support and local manufacturing; accept or reject the edge.

inputs.proposed_mechanism: Japanese strategic-investment support can transmit into TSMC through the binding Sony-controlled Kumamoto image-sensor venture, local advanced-process manufacturing and phased TSMC capital contributions.
inputs.proposed_invalidation: Reject or downgrade the edge if approvals or government support fail, the 2029 ramp slips, Sony-controlled economics are immaterial to TSMC, or returns on the JPY282 billion commitment are inadequate.
